programs.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programs.sub_title: Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies
programs.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programs.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programs.sub_title: Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf
programs.desc: Exploring the historic Lea & Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its legendary Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837. He then heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, home of the beloved malt loaf, where he joins the production line and experiments with creating a new flavour.

programs.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish"
programs.sub_title: Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish
programs.desc: To discover how his favourite meal—fish supper followed by rice pudding—is made, Lord Prescott visits the Ambrosia factory in Devon to explore the production of classic British desserts. Returning north to Grimsby, he heads to the Young's factory to learn about their famous fish pie.

programs.title: Power & S2 - "Lucas Toledo"
programs.desc: After yet another public transport strike in their hometown Cordoba, Argentina, Lucas Toledo and two of his friends decided to design a foldable electric bike.

programs.title: Power & S2 - "Tabb Firchau"
programs.desc: Tabb Firchau is a cameraman who co-founded Freefly systems to design and build camera stabilizers and unmanned aerial vehicles that were easy to operate.

programs.title: Power & S2 - "Shane Chen"
programs.desc: Shane Chen is an inventor. Or to use his own words, he is a “tinkerer” – a fellow who makes a living from molding mechanisms into quirky creations.
